items.text: I can explain cloud computing in one sentence using the official definition
I know all five NIST characteristics of cloud computing
I can list all six advantages of cloud computing
I understand CAPEX vs OPEX and why cloud shifts spending
I can explain IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS with AWS examples for each
I know the difference between Private, Public, and Hybrid Cloud — and when to use each
I can explain what an AWS Region is and give three region code examples
I know the minimum (3) and maximum (6) Availability Zones per Region
I understand why AZs are physically separated (disaster isolation)
I know AWS has 400+ Points of Presence across 40+ countries
I can name four AWS Global Services (IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, WAF)
I understand the four region selection factors: Compliance, Latency, Availability, Pricing
I can explain 'Security OF the cloud' (AWS) vs 'Security IN the cloud' (customer)
I know who patches the OS on EC2 (customer) vs RDS database engine (AWS)
I understand how responsibility shifts between IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
I know data transfer IN is free, data transfer OUT is charged
I can identify which AWS services are global vs regional
I can answer Shared Responsibility Model scenario questions correctly
I know the three AWS pricing fundamentals: Compute, Storage, Data Transfer OUT
I understand that Compliance always overrides other region selection factors
I can distinguish between the three deployment models in exam scenarios
